text: Valorous Scourgeborne Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 damage death knight set.
Valorous Cryptstalker Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 hunter set.
Valorous Redemption Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 retribution paladin set.
Valorous Plagueheart Garb is the 25-man version of the tier 7 warlock set.
Valorous Dreadnaught Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 damage warrior set.
Valorous Scourgeborne Plate is the 25-man version of the tier 7 tank death knight set.
Valorous Bonescythe Battlegear is the 25-man version of the tier 7 rogue set.
Valorous Redemption Regalia is the 25-man version of the tier 7 holy paladin set.
Valorous Kirin Tor Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 8 mage set. It resembles the armor worn by mages such as Aethas Sunreaver and Archmage Modera in Dalaran.
Valorous Scourgestalker Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 hunter set.
Valorous Darkruned Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 damage death knight set.
Valorous Darkruned Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 8 tank death knight set.
Valorous Nightsong Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 8 balance druid set.
Valorous Aegis Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 8 protection paladin set.
Valorous Aegis Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 8 holy paladin set.
Valorous Aegis Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 retribution paladin set.
Valorous Nightsong Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 feral druid set.
Valorous Nightsong Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 8 restoration druid set.
Valorous Sanctification Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 8 damage priest set.
Valorous Sanctification Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 8 healing priest set.
Valorous Deathbringer Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 8 warlock set.
Valis Windchaser is a blood elf found at Argent Tournament in Icecrown. He is the master of the Shield-Breaker. He was present during Death Rising.
Valoku was a nether dragon who along with Zzeraku was one of the first nether dragons encountered by Tyrygosa in her journey to Outland.

Valishj is a naga sea witch located in Slitherblade Shore in Desolace. She is friendly as long as you wear the naga disguise for the quest Going Deep. She has the habit of calling those under her command "little minnow." She was killed by Lord Hydronis.
Valorn Stillbough is a night elf and part of the expeditionary force in Gilneas.

Valewalker Farodin is an ancient night elf hermit living in the wilds of Suramar. As the last of the keepers of the arcan'dor trees, he helped the nightfallen grow and sustain their arcan'dor in Shal'Aran and freed them from their addiction to the Nightwell.
Valkasha is an orc who wrote to Fizzle Goblinseer due to all the severed heads being brought in by adventurers when she put up a wanted poster for Rend Blackhand.
Valonius is a green dragon located at the Serene Dreams Spa in Thaldraszus. He is telling Uncle Mako about his dreams.
Varo'then was the leader of Queen Azshara's personal guard during the War of the Ancients.
Vanteg is a Mag'har orc reagent and poison vendor located at Garadar in Nagrand.
Vanessa Sellers is a human shard trader found in Simply Enchanting in Dalaran.
Valorous Siegebreaker Plate is the 10-man version of the tier 8 tank warrior set.
Valorous Siegebreaker Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 damage warrior set.
Valorous Terrorblade Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 rogue set.
Valorous Worldbreaker Garb is the 10-man version of the tier 8 elemental shaman set.
Valorous Worldbreaker Battlegear is the 10-man version of the tier 8 enhancement shaman set.
Valorous Worldbreaker Regalia is the 10-man version of the tier 8 restoration shaman set.
Varas is a night elf weapon vendor located at Blackfathom Camp in Ashenvale. Occasionally, he can be seen hammering on the anvil.

High Priest Vandellor was a high elf priest and a close friend of Grand Magister Belo'vir, and of Liadrin's family. After the parents of the future Blood Knight Matriarch died, Vandellor adopted the girl.
Vandel is a high ranking night elf demon hunter of the Illidari.
Vampiric Fangs is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Grim Perseverance, Rattling Bones (artifact trait), and Sanguinary Affinity traits.
Vampiric Aura is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Carrion Feast and Souldrinker (death knight artifact trait) traits.
Vargy is an orc located in the Royal Meat Rack in the Great Seal.
Varis was a human knight from and one of the first to encounter orcs invading from . He and Karos were 's lieutenants. Varis died at the when snapped his neck.
Vanesh Winemonger is a night elf ghost located in the Drowned Market in Nazjatar.

Veldan Lightfoot is a human shield vendor located at the Westbrook Garrison in Elwynn Forest. He can be found in the keep, in a room to the right of the entrance, beside Quartermaster Hicks and Quartermaster Hudson.
Veira Langdon is a level 74 human general goods vendor located at the Westfall Brigade Encampment in the Grizzly Hills.

Vasarin Redmorn is a blood elf quartermaster with the Sunreavers. He can be found in the Sunreaver Pavilion of the Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown. He offers various items to players who have earned the achievement . After the Purge of Dalaran, Vasarin took up arms with the Sunreaver Onslaught, reprising his role as quartermaster. He can initially be found aboard the Crimson Treader, and will relocate to Dawnseeker's Promontory when the base is established. He was present at the Argent Tournament Grounds during Death Rising.
Velastrasza is a red dragon in a high elf guise, standing next to Baleflame, at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands. Velastrasza can also be found in Grim Batol.
Vaughn Blusterbeard is the Wildhammer dwarf innkeeper in Kirthaven in the Twilight Highlands.
Veir is a night elf stable master located at Dreamer's Rest in Feralas.
Varx Hagglemore is a goblin general goods vendor located at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

Veesha Blazeweaver is a troll mage part of the Hodir encounter in Ulduar. She, along with her party is trapped in blocks of ice and must be freed to help against the frost titans attacks. If the raid is in the 25man version of Ulduar then she will be replaced by Amira Blazeweaver.
Varsha is an orc located in front of the Spirit Lodge in Frostwall.
Velandros Sunblessing is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Vasushen is an orc vendor located outside the Bladespire Citadel in Frostfire Ridge.
Vel'karozz is a fel lord that appears in the Hillsbrad Foothills.
Vassallorand Nightmist is a night elf vendor located in the Temple of Elune in Val'sharah.

Velaris is an blood elf who is a patron of the Hearthstone Inn. A blood elf aristocrat and far too rich for bad taste. Likes to win and hates to lose. Friend of himself. Velaris HS.jpg|Velaris in Hearth and Home. Velaris in Warcraft Arclight Rumble Cinematic.png|Velaris in Warcraft Arclight Rumble Cinematic Trailer.
Veinrender is a Blood death knight artifact trait. It is linked to the Iron Heart (artifact trait) and Umbilicus Eternus (artifact trait) traits.
Vaughn is a human located in the Arathi Highlands. When approached during the Battle for Stromgarde, he is in front of his house with a broom in his hands.
Veladormi is a bronze dragon located at the Ruby Life Pools in the Waking Shores.

Velog Icebellow is the king of the Frostborn; having taken over the position after Muradin Bronzebeard, known to his people as Yorg Stormheart, recovered his memories and departed back to his own. He resides at Frosthold in the Storm Peaks, and is known to be considered like a brother to Muradin.
Vengeful Hui is a pandaren spirit located in the Greenstone Village scenario.
Vella A'nar is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Venomous Bite is a level 60 beast mastery hunter talent which will reduces the cooldown of Bestial Wrath every time that Cobra Shot is used.
Venagosa is a dead blue dragon located in the Siege Creche in the Forbidden Reach.
Veligos was a blue dragon. It is unknown how he died. His name is on a Crumbling Gravestone at the Veiled Ossuary.
Veron Amberstill is a dwarf ram vendor located at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. He was present during the Legion Invasions.
Veraku is a nether dragon located at the southern part of the Celestial Ridge in Netherstorm.
Verinias is a Highborne night elf that was transformed into the terrorguard named Verinias the Twisted while about to leave Darkmist in Feralas.
Veridis Fallon is a night elf ghost located in Azsuna. He sells rewards from the Court of Farondis faction.
Veri'thas was a mage who gifted a jewel to the Lost Abbey. The trinket was later allegedly stolen after a conflict between the monks and the elves.

Vermera (nicknamed Mera) is a wounded green dragon being healed by Sidra the Mender in the northern part of the Shady Sanctuary in the Ohn'ahran Plains; she was injured in the Primalist attack on the Emerald Gardens. She disappears sometime after completion of the quest Shady Sanctuary (quest).
Vharr is an orc weapon vendor located in Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
Vethsera is a green dragon member the Brood of Ysera. She uses a night elf visage.
Vesina Yeslin is a human located at the Lunarfall's Dwarven Bunker in .
Veteran Sergeant Slayde is a human located in Ar'gorok in Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Veteran Reaver Kromshok is an orc located in Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde. He is one of the Reavers of the Tempest's Roar crew.
Verra Fireblood is a Dark Iron dwarf located in the Brewfest Grounds in Dun Morogh during Brewfest.

Vice Admiral Keller is a human found in Valgarde in the Howling Fjord. He has a wife and three kids in Elwynn Forest. Captain Adams considered him an insufferable egomaniac. He starts the introductory quest line for the Alliance in the area. Questers must complete his first few quests before the rest of the quest givers in Valgarde start offering quests.
Vikki Lonsav is a human innkeeper located in Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. Before the Cataclysm, she was a general goods vendor.
Vicious Strikes is a death knight talent located on tier 1 of the Unholy tree.

Viciousness is a passive worgen racial trait that increases the character's critical strike chance by 1%. This buff affects both spell crit and melee crit, and is useful for both damage dealing and healing.
Victor is a human child found with a group of kids east of Southshore in the Escape from Durnholde Keep, Caverns of Time, instance. It's unknown what become of him.
Victorina is a night elf vendor located at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.
Viik is a draenei warrior trainer located at Blood Watch in Bloodmyst Isle.
Vidar Goldaim is a dwarf located at Lunarfall in . He can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Lunarfall Inn.
Victor Esquivias is a human located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus.
Victor's Point Captain is a human located at Victor's Point in the Twilight Highlands.
Lady Victoria Snyder is a deceased human buried at Barrowknoll Cemetery in Drustvar.
Vigil Hill Mercenary is a human encountered by Horde champions on Vigil Hill in Tiragarde Sound.
Vik Mournblade is a Darkfallen death knight seen speaking with Kaln Vilehoof in Warfang Hold in Stormsong Valley.
Vida Bloodsun is a blood elf located in Camp Nowhere in the Azure Span.

Vindicator Boros is a draenei vindicator and a member of the Triumvirate of the Hand, the leaders of the Hand of Argus. He is initially found as a quest giver at Blood Watch on Bloodmyst Isle, and later moved in the Sanctum of Light beneath Light's Hope Chapel as a champion and leader of the Order of the Silver Hand. He has dedicated himself to renew the sacred vows of the Hand of Argus at all costs and refuses to let their legacy die. During the third invasion of the Burning Legion, he pledged the allegiance of the Hand of Argus to the reformed Order of the Silver Hand, and pledged his services to its new Highlord. As a member of the order's war council, he participated in the meetings for

Vindicator Saruan was a draenei vindicator and a member of the Triumvirate of the Hand in Blood Watch of Bloodmyst Isle. He was the master, teacher and mentor of Vindicator Kuros, who took Saruan's place in the Triumvirate after the vindicator vanished and the search for him was abandoned. During a patrol, Saruan was captured by the Sunhawk blood elves and subjected to harsh torture at the hands of Matis the Cruel. Matis beat the vindicator repeatedly until he lost consciousness, at which point the elf attempted to wake him by splashing contagion laced water across his ravaged body, but Saruan did not wake. Saruan's fellow captive Galaen, who witnessed the torture and was killed by the elves
Vincent Hersham is a human attempting to help Sean Dempsey from his injures from the hostile worgen within Stoneward Prison.
Vincent Randolph is a human blacksmithing vendor found at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Violent Sigils is a level 102 Vengeance demon hunter talent.
Vincent is a human child located in Mariner's Row in Boralus.
Vinter Tysiel is a void elf found at the Brewfest Grounds during Brewfest in Dun Morogh.
Virulence was a Death knight talent located in the 1st tier of the Unholy Tree.
Vivienne Blackwhisper is a Horde Forsaken priest with a chance to appear in the Trial of the Crusader against the Alliance.
Visera Softloam is a night elf food and drink vendor located at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.
Vital Conviction is a level 100 monk talent, added in Warlords of Draenor.

Vivianne is a Forsaken mage first found in Frostwall, when the garrison is first starting out, then moves to Warspear of Ashran soon after. She was sent by Sylvanas to assist the commander. She can be recruited by Horde adventurers to serve as a Follower in their Garrison. She is later seen fighting in the Path of Glory when the Horde attacked Azuka. She can also be seen watching fights between garrison commanders in the Coliseum of Highmaul.
Vivalia Sundagger is a blood elf follower located at the Frostwall in Frostfire Ridge. She can only be recruited using the Headhunter's Harvest from Frostwall Tavern.
Virulator Ructus is a scientist who spawns to fight Alexandros Mograine and the player in Maldraxxus' House of Constructs during Pursuit of Justice (Kyrian)/Pursuit of Justice (Necrolord). __NOTOC__
Voar Grimleer was an orc, presumably caught in the Grimleer Shackle.
Vishas is a human family that originated from Lordamere Lake.
Voidhunter Yar is a level 68 rare voidlord demon that has been spotted around Oshu'gun in Nagrand.
Voidreaver Urnae is an orc located at the Pillars of Fate in the Spires of Arak.
Void Cleave is an Arms warrior major artifact trait. It is linked to the Unending Rage trait.
Void Corruption is a Shadow priest artifact trait. It is linked to the Void Siphon (priest artifact trait), Thoughts of Insanity and Mental Fortitude (artifact trait) traits.
Void Gargantuan is a void god located at the Azure Dragonshrine in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.

Vol'kaal was a dire troll member of the Zanchuli Council and also acted as the bodyguard and lieutenant to Yazma until he betrayed Rastakhan as part of the Atal'zul. He was then raised into undeath and relocated to Atal'Dazar.

Vol'Jim was a human rare mob located under the bridge just south of Norwington Estate in Tiragarde Sound. He wore a male troll mask. Originally listed as a criterion of the Adventurer of Tiragarde Sound achievement, Vol'Jim was at some point removed from its requirements.
Voidsmith Aowyn is a void elf located in Redfield's Watch in Nazmir.
Void Binder Kulra is an orc located at the Burial Fields in .
Voloren is a night elf fishing vendor located in the Temple Gardens in Darnassus. It is unknown whether he survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.

Vor'athil was a black-haired high elf ranger who served under Sylvanas Windrunner's command during the Third War. He was one of the three scouts sent to investigate the Scourge army, the other two being Kelmarin and Sheldaris. While Kelmarin returned to Sylvanas to inform her about the approaching army, he and Sheldaris had waited for Sylvanas to come with the bulk of the rangers. He was killed by a gargoyle during the first struggle with the Scourge, and later raised as an undead. He had his long black hair swept back in a ponytail, tanned skin, pointed ears and eyes blue as summer skies.

Voldana is a high elf from Quel'Danil Lodge who fought with Dougan and Kardan against the Horde during the Second War. When Dougan heard townsfolk were disappearing from investigating the cursed tower of Karazhan, he ventured off with Kardan and Voldana to rescue the missing villagers. The evils of the tower was too much and while Kardan and Voldana escaped, Dougan was left behind. Kardan and Voldana delivered the sad news to Dougan's wife Adena. Yet so immense was her grief that her mind snapped and she became unfit to raise her twin baby girls. And so Voldana and Kardan decided to honor their colleague by raising the twin girls as their own. Voldana raised Loania in Quel'Danil Lodge. When
Vordrastrasz is a red dragon located at the Vermillion Redoubt in the Twilight Highlands.
Voodooist Timan is a forest troll member of the Blackrock clan. He overlooks the Pillar of Ash from the top of an eastern tower in the Burning Steppes.
Vorcha is an orc stable master for the Horde outpost of Silverwind Refuge recently taken in Ashenvale.
Vorpil Ribcleaver is a member of the . When aggroed, he transforms from a brown-skinned orc to a corrupted fel one, complete with demon wings.

Volo Morin is the Horde rogue leader of Ashran. He is found alongside the Paladin Leader Danne Lukesi in a small room to the left of the Horde Generals in Warspear Keep, presumably waiting to join the fight should the Generals be attacked.

Vora Strongarm is an orc bartender. She is only accessible if the player has built Frostwall Tavern as one of their garrison buildings, or if the player is visiting another player's garrison which has the building.
Vorel Steelspire is a dwarf. She is a graduate of Brock's School of Mining and Surveying and Gremlock's School of Caterers.
Volde is a blood elf located at the Axefall in the Spires of Arak.

Vormu is a bronze dragon in dwarven form. responsible for allowing players to queue for Black Temple, Ulduar and Firelands Timewalking during The Burning Crusade, Wrath of the Lich King and Cataclysm Timewalking events, respectively.
Vontair is a paladin who alongside with his warrior companion, Emor, spied on the goblin sapper, Mareek, who wanted to blow up a rock blocking a tunnel.
Vol'mar Magus is a blood elf located in Vol'mar in Tanaan Jungle.
Volcanakk is a rare elite proto-dragon inside the Siege Creche of the Stormsunder Crater in eastern Forbidden Reach.
Vosur Brakthel is a dwarf located in the shop Berryfizz's Potions and Mixed Drinks in Tinker Town in Ironforge.
Vrok Blunderblast is a dwarf gun vendor located in Thelsamar in Loch Modan.
Vrang Wildgore is an orc weapon and armor vendor located in a camp northwest of Dreadmist Peak in the Northern Barrens.
Vrok is an orc trade goods vendor located at Bor'gorok Outpost in the Borean Tundra.
Vyr is a human located at Sanctuary of the Void in Netherlight Temple. He is found kneeling in front the large shelf of candles and cannot be interacted with.
Vyrastrasza is a red dragon resting inside the Ruby Sanctum. She can be encountered by the Deathlord and can also be killed, but it is not the objective.

Vrykul Shield Training is a Protection warrior artifact trait. It is linked to the Rage of the Fallen, Toughness (warrior artifact trait), Wall of Steel, and Will to Survive (warrior artifact trait) traits.
Vorus'arak is a nerubian spiderlord located at in the Skittering Hollow, he is the leader of a group of living nerubians known as Voru'kar.
Vragor is an orc shaman located in Frostfire Ridge. He had a totem. He was to be exiled along with .

Margrave Vyraz was the self-proclaimed ruler of Maldraxxus' House of the Chosen. Originally known as Baron Vyraz, he served under Margrave Krexus as one of the house's two barons, but later revealed himself to be a traitor working with the Mawsworn and their allies, killed Krexus, and took control of the house. He subsequently stationed himself with Helya in the Maw, but was slain by Baroness Draka and her allies during the covenants' attack on Desmotaeron.
Wagner Hammerstrike is a dwarf fireworks vendor located outside at the Gates of Ironforge in Dun Morogh during the Harvest Festival. He also sends a letter which contains Bounty of the Harvest.

Wand Specialization was a mage talent that increased wand damage by up to 25% at max rank. Most mages use wand damage only as a last resort, making this talent less useful, especially when compared to other talents that could be taken in its place. It was removed from the game in patch 3.0.2. Priests had a similar talent, Wand Specialization (priest talent) in their Discipline tree, which increases wand damage by 5% per rank, up to 25% at max rank.
Walt is a dwarf of the Explorers' League located in Explorers' League Outpost in Howling Fjord.
Wagtan is an orc innkeeper located at the Frostwolf Overlook in Talador.
Walking Dead is a Blood death knight PvP talent, available at level 20.
Wallis Crowder is a human located at the Crimson Coast in Drustvar. He is a part of the Crimson Cutthroats, a notorious band of outlaws.
Walther Mills is a human located in Arom's Stand in Drustvar. He is also present during Faction Assaults.
Walter Ferrell is a human located in Blushwater Brook in Tiragarde Sound. He and Bradford Crusco protect Mead Barrels.
Waldin Thorbatt is a human who didn't make it into the live game.
Wandering Plague is a death knight talent located on tier 9 of the Unholy tree.
Wanda Chanter is a human wand vendor found in the Militant Mystic of Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, she was cowering in fear. When Dalaran moved to Deadwind Pass, she was dizzy.

War-God Jalak is the master of Horridon and leader of the Zandalari Beast Ward. He takes part to the fight only if the life of Horridon is under 30% or if the four tribes have been called. He has disciples.
War-Hunter Molog was an orc located in Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar. Next to him was Greela "The Grunt" Crankchain.
Wanderer's Hardiness is a Brewmaster monk artifact trait. It is only available after acquiring all other artifact traits.
Wanda is a human who appears in Bridgeport in Stormsong Valley during Bridgeport Investigation.
Warboss Nekrogg is a fel orc found on top of a wall in Hellfire Peninsula.
Warchief Blackhand is an orc chess piece in Karazhan's Chess Event.
Warcaster Bargol is an orc located north of the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands.
Warbringer Kro'goth is an orc located at Valorcall Pass in the Arathi Highlands during the Battle for Stromgarde.
Warg Deepwater is a dwarf fishing trainer located on the western bank of the Loch in Loch Modan.

Warden Nork Bloodfrenzy is an orc and the father of Ug'thor Bloodfrenzy found outside of Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. While looking at the Alliance Deserters he asks his son if he knows what they are. Having never seen a human before Ug'thor asked if they were pigs and when informed by his father that they are cowards he asks if they are cowardly pigs. With a shake of his head Nork tells his son that they are soldiers of the Alliance, the Horde's sworn enemy. Nork then tells his son that the deserters are afraid to die, a concept which confuses him. After stating his confusion he puffs out his chest, stands on his tip-toes, and declares to his father. Nork then congratulates his son be

Warden Alturas is a human located in front of the Violet Hold in Dalaran. He seems to be the man in control of the prison. When the demon hunter champion requested to access the Violet Hold in order to interrogate an eredar, Alturas let them in. He didn't trust the demon hunters, believing them to be the same as other demons.
Warden Azjakir is the leader of the naga forces in the Clutch of Kelp'thar Forest, keeping watch over Alliance and Horde prisoners. Erunak Stonespeaker wants him dead.
Warden Gartok Ragefist was an orc located at the Ring of Valor in Orgrimmar. He was holding Detained Cultists captives.
Warden Virgil is a level 90 human member of the Timewalkers found at Celestial Court of Timeless Isle.
Warden Chadrik is a human found at Celestial Court of Timeless Isle. Unlike other members of the Timewalkers, he is not tagged as its member and is also friendly rather than neutral.
Warcrier Tarrak is an orc located at the Vol'jin's Pride in Talador.
Warleader Tome is a level 100 elite orc riding around in . He is accompanied by 12 Nagrand Warriders.
Warlord's Challenge is a level 60 Protection warrior talent.
Warden Amical is a human located in Tol Dagor during the extraction of Priscilla Ashvane.
Warden Captain Sinjoirmi is a blood elf located at the Temporal Conflux in Thaldraszus.

Warlord Krellian is a naga residing in the Temple of Zin-Malor in Azshara and he is the cruel royal leader of the Spitelash Naga. With Arkkoroc dealt with, the naga took the upper hand and marched on the new arrivals, the Bilgewater Cartel goblins. He already seems to be a worthy adversary, for he led a small group of naga against a horde platoon led by Sergeant Dynamo and won. Before the Cataclysm, Archmage Xylem wanted the prismatic shell that Krellian possessed.

Warlord Gorchuk is an orc located at the Scarab Dais in Silithus alongside Senior Sergeant Kai'jin during the Call of the Scarab micro-holiday. Gorchuk, along with his Alliance counterpart Field Marshal Snowfall, is a callback to the massive item funneling that took place during the War Effort to open the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj. As his gossip text hints at, players on the entire realm ended up focusing their efforts to get a single player his or her The Scepter of the Shifting Sands to bang the gong and start the war.
Warmage Ilsudria is a high elf located at the Violet Stand in Crystalsong Forest.
Warmage Halister is a human located at the Violet Stand in the Crystalsong Forest.
Warmage Sarina is a human located at the Violet Stand in Crystalsong Forest.

Warmage Kath'leen is a human located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. She can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran. With the invasion of the Burning Legion, she joined the effort of the Armies of Legionfall as one of their artificers.
Warmage Lukems is a high elf located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. He can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran.
Warmage Mumplina is a human located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. She can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran.
Warmage Silva is a human located near the Violet Citadel in Dalaran. He can provide directions for various locations in the Dalaran.
Warlord Gar'dul is the former leader of Desolation Hold in Southern Barrens.
Warlord Halthar is a Dragonmaw orc at the Thundermar Ruins in Twilight Highlands.
Warlord Noktyn is the third Horde general in Ashran, found in the Warspear Keep in Warspear Outpost, to the left of High Warlord Volrath. He also serves as Honor gear vendor.

Warlord Kao was the favored general of the Thunder King, resurrected by the Zandalari trolls to help his master reclaim his hold on Pandaria. During the Fourth War, he sought to fulfill the pact the Zandalari had made with the mogu long ago, but was put down by champions of the Horde.
Warlord Kolbine is an ogre barbarian and the ruler of the Deadwind ogres of the Deadwind Ogre Mounds in Deadwind Pass.
Warmongering Combatant's Desecration is the Warlords Season 3 death knight arena set.
Warmongering Combatant's Pursuit is the Warlords Season 3 hunter arena set.
Warmongering Combatant's Regalia is the Warlords Season 3 mage arena set.
Warmongering Combatant's Pursuit is the Warlords Season 3 monk arena set.
Warmongering Combatant's Investiture is the Warlords Season 3 priest arena set.
Warmongering Combatant's Battlegear is the Warlords Season 3 warrior arena set.
Warmaster Garrick is an orc that spawns with Frostwolf Warriors and Seasoned Reavers in Alterac Valley.
Warlord Surgios is the leader of Scalefang Outpost in Vol'dun. He loves shiny, rotating things and has stolen Dataguru Gryzix's "mind enhancer" helmet.
Warp-Huntress Kula is an orc hunter who wanders around Dalaran with her warp stalker Backbiter and acts like a player (using Hearthstone, training professions, checking the bank, etc.).
Warmongering Gladiator's Desecration is the Warlords Season 3 death knight arena set.
Warmongering Gladiator's Pursuit is the Warlords Season 3 hunter arena set.
Warmongering Gladiator's Regalia is the Warlords Season 3 mage arena set.
Warmongering Gladiator's Ironskin is the Warlords Season 3 monk arena set.
Warmongering Gladiator's Investiture is the Warlords Season 3 priest arena set.
Warmongering Gladiator's Battlegear is the Warlords Season 3 warrior arena set.
Warsong Recruitment Officer is an orc located at Warsong Hold in the Borean Tundra. This is the first NPC you come to as you enter Warsong Hold.

Warrith was a Broken leader. He and his tribe were often hunted by the nether drakes Valoku and Zzeraku. He acted as a guide for Jorad Mace and Tyri when they were trying to find the lair of the attacking nether drakes. He died protecting them from Ragnok Bloodreaver's fel orcs.
Warspear Mage is an orc found in the Tower of Elements in Warspear on Ashran. She holds open the portal to Orgrimmar.
Tailoring Emporium is an orc tailor located in the Frostwall's Tailoring Emporium. For tailors, she will sell new formulas. For non-tailors, she will make items instead.
Warsong Gulch Herald is a dwarf ghost located in Warsong Gulch announcing the progress of the battle.
Warsong Leader is a Mag'har orc located in the Nagrand Arena.

Watch Commander Zalaphil was a rare mob human found in the receiving room of Tiragarde Keep in Durotar. He was friendly towards Alliance players. He was a higher ranking Kul Tiras soldier and was dispatched with Lieutenant Benedict to continue Admiral Proudmoore's goal of taking Durotar and killing the orcs. Following the tsunami that ravaged Tiragarde Keep after the Cataclysm, he was replaced by Sergeant Curtis from Northwatch.
Watchman Doomgrip is a Dark Iron dwarf found in Blackrock Depths. He is summoned when you open all lockers of the Black Vault. The Secret Safe spawns upon his death.
Watcher Biggs is a human located southeast of Splinterspear Junction in the Swamp of Sorrows. He was escorting a caravan from Darkshire to Nethergarde Keep, but the group was ambushed by Lost Ones.
Watch Commander Leonus is a human stationed in Honor Hold in the contested territory of the Hellfire Peninsula. He will warn the town when an infernal rain is about to come down.
Watcher Selkin is a human who could be found on the road north of the Rotting Orchard in Duskwood when Stitches was on the loose.
Watcher Petras is a human found in Duskwood, patrolling the town of Darkshire. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Petras and some other watchers joined the Veiled Hand.
Watcher Paige is a human located by the central crossroad in Duskwood.

Watcher Mocarski is a human found in Darkshire in Duskwood. He can be found guarding the southern entrance to the town. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Mocarski and some other watchers joined the Veiled Hand.
Watcher Merant is a human found in Duskwood where she would patrol the road north of the Rotting Orchard.
Watcher Keefer is a human found in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Keefer and some other watchers joined the Veiled Hand.
Watcher Hutchins is a human found at the central crossroads of Duskwood.
Watcher Gelwin is a human found at the road north of the Rotting Orchard in Duskwood.
Watcher Fraizer is a human found in Darkshire in Duskwood. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Fraizer and some other watchers joined the Veiled Hand.
Watcher Blomberg is a human found at the central crossroad in Duskwood.
Watcher Lara is a level 90 human member of the Timewalkers found at Tushui Landing of Timeless Isle.
Watcher Bianca is a level 90 human member of the Timewalkers found at Celestial Court of Timeless Isle.
Watcher Megana is a human found at Celestial Court of Timeless Isle. Unlike other members of the Timewalkers, she is not tagged as its member and is also friendly rather than neutral.
Watcher Theronus was a human from Nethergarde located at the Dark Portal in the Blasted Lands during the Dark Portal Opens event. He was accompanied by two Nethergarde Advisors.
Watchman Kovak is a human located at the Southport‎ in Spires of Arak.
Watcher Kern is a human who didn't make it into the live game. He is named after Mark Kern.
Watcher Jeph is a human located in Millstone Hamlet in Stormsong Valley.
Wavebinder Se'sha was a level 92 Kor'kron Commander orc located at Northern Barrens.
Wave-Caller Zulga is an orc located at Theramore Isle in Dustwallow Marsh during Theramore's Fall.
Waxmancer Sturmi is a kobold hunter featured in the Kobolds & Catacombs expansion for Hearthstone. Waxmancer Sturmi is a kobold who specializes in wax alteration.
Waycrest Captain is a human encountered by Horde champions in Mudfisher Cove in Drustvar.
Water Traveler is a night elf that transports the player during Two If By Boat (Alliance) in Thousand Needles.
Weapon Mastery is the Arms warrior secondary stat attunement, focusing on mastery.
Weathered Nomad is a human pilot of the Confiscated Artillery in northern Uldum.

Weaponmaster Asvard is a Valarjar warrior trainer residing in Skyhold. He is a skilled master of arms, and seemingly oversees the training of many Valarjar from the Arena of Glory. Later during the campaign on the Broken Isles, Asvard would travel to Deliverance Point on the Broken Shore. There, he continued to train Valarjar forces alongside Jacqueline Sage as part of the Armies of Legionfall.
Waylon Stormsong was a member of House Stormsong. A memorial in his honor is located in Proudmoore Academy in Boralus.
Wayneth Antonius is a human. He was originally a reference to game designer Luis Barriga. In patch 9.1.5, he was internally changed from Luis Barriga to Wayneth Antonius.
Werg Thickblade is an orc leatherworking vendor located at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.
Wenna Silkbeard is a dwarf speciality goods vendor located in the inn at Swiftgear Station in Sundown Marsh in the Wetlands.
Wesley was a human stable master located in Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills. He stood beside the mailbox in front of the Inn. He is nowhere to be found after the destruction of Southshore.
Wendy Darren is a human found at the Farshire farms in the Borean Tundra.
Wembil Taskwidget is a gnome profession trainer located in Kharanos in the dwarf and gnome starting zone of Dun Morogh. He was rescued by an adventurer during the Legion invasions.
Werner Eastbrook is a human stable master found at Fort Triumph in the Southern Barrens. His status after the fall of Fort Triumph just prior to the destruction of Theramore Isle is unknown.
Wembly is a gnome character in Smokywood Pastures Presents: A Winter Veil Carol.
Weird Beard is a human located at the Seabreak Isle in Azsuna.
Wes is a human located at the Bizmo's Brawlpub and Brawl'gar Arena.
